keep_features.feature_value: High (Michael Lewis, The Fifth Risk, Trump)
keep_features.evidence_span: "The Fifth Risk" by Michael Lewis ... Trump
keep_features.rationale: The post includes multiple named entities and a cited book/authors.

keep_features.feature_value: Claims sanctions lead to Russia running out of funds/equipment
keep_features.evidence_span: "Sanctions are working fantastically on Russia" ... "Their reserve funds are running out"
keep_features.rationale: It asserts a direct causal relationship between sanctions and observed outcomes.

keep_features.feature_value: Frames Ukrainians as victims of killing if sanctions removed
keep_features.rationale: It portrays a harm threat targeted at Ukrainians.
The text uses morally loaded negative descriptors for actors.

keep_features.feature_value: Endorses lawmakers and calls for action to gain a gun-safety majority
keep_features.evidence_span: "I’m proud to endorse" ... "fight for the change we all deserve."
keep_features.rationale: It includes an explicit political action/endorsement toward a policy goal.

keep_features.feature_value: Accuses climate framing as a coordinated psyop
keep_features.rationale: Calling it a psyop indicates conspiratorial/propaganda framing.
It is a direct quoted statement establishing a categorical claim.
The message is only a short intensifier phrase with emotion.

remove_features.feature_value: Switches from pro-Palestine to pro-Israel/Hamas blame assignment
remove_features.evidence_span: "supports Israel's right to defend itself" ... "side with Hamas"
remove_features.rationale: The mirror frames one political side as defending itself while the other is aligned with Hamas.

remove_features.feature_value: Multiple explicit profanity slurs toward targets
remove_features.evidence_span: "fuck right off. Fuck trump. Fuck Walmart."
remove_features.rationale: The text uses repeated coarse profanity targeting people and organizations.

remove_features.evidence_span: "tell you or someone else of your ilk"
remove_features.rationale: The author is speaking to the reader in second person.

remove_features.feature_value: Plans political/civic activities (register voters, petitions, candidates)
remove_features.evidence_span: "register voters, gather petitions for our Dem candidates"
remove_features.rationale: It lists intended mobilization actions rather than merely describing opinions.
The post ends with an emphatic expletive/accusation expressing anger.

remove_features.feature_value: Labels a named politician as 'communist' in violent condemning language
remove_features.rationale: It applies a severe ideological label with profanity to a specific named figure.

remove_features.feature_value: Explicit contrast between open carry and concealed carry
remove_features.rationale: It juxtaposes two categories of gun carry with evaluative statements.

remove_features.feature_value: Imperative demand to expel visa holders/shutdown
remove_features.evidence_span: "All visa holders go home" "shut the USA down!"
remove_features.rationale: It issues direct commands advocating exclusion and disruption.
